L-011.label: a: drop T3 count as a control; b: accept WP2 on gates + tests; replan
L-011.a: Do not confirm or reject it-003 on T3: the T3 finding count is not a valid control. Same build, same day, byte-identical prompts gave be-vs-5546 2/5/4 and be-vs-3571 3/3/6 (it-003/scratch/t3-same-day-ab.txt); the count says nothing about quality (be-vs-5546 stored recording: 1 medium correctness bug + 3 low items; the human MR comments were 2 style/structure items). Replace T3 as a control with stability of medium-and-above findings across runs, and make the recorder keep every run instead of overwriting by snapshot id (only counts survive in record-*.log today).
L-011.b: Accept WP2 on gates plus its reproducing tests. Do not make a human VS-* cycle a per-iteration condition: product changes per iteration are small and the owner will not run the work repository for each. Replace per-iteration T4 with an automated proxy: headless investigate/plan/task sessions on a fixture repository (fixtures/materialize.mjs) with a stub requirements MCP server, scored by tools/transcript-metrics.py (fabricated provenance, refused review launches, MCP-server questions). The owner human cycle (L-010) becomes one confirmation at the end of cycle 1, not a gate for each WP.
L-011.also: Measurement costs dominate (~$136 of ~$161 on sweeps): run the full 3-run/arm T2 decision sweep only at checkpoints, with a 1-run screening per iteration. This changes 01/02/03, so do it through a replan (09 §2); this label is the owner confirmation it needs.
